description_en: Deletes an application based on a specified process identifier (PID) and application type
description_zh: 删除指定ID或类型的应用
kebab_example: aliyun arms delete-trace-app --app-id 540600 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type TRACE --pid 9w0sc5gxxz@edcsd447c2f0000 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteTraceApp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application that you want to delete. You can call the SearchTraceAppByName operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130676.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的应用的ID，可调用SearchTraceAppByName接口获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the application is located
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application that you want to delete. You can call the SearchTraceAppByName operation to query the application type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130676.html. Valid values:

`TRACE`: Application Monitoring
`RETCODE`: frontend monitoring
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的应用的类型，可调用SearchTraceAppByName接口获取，更多信息，请参见SearchTraceAppByName。包括以下类型：

`TRACE`：应用监控
`RETCODE`：前端监控
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The PID of the application. For more information about how to query the PID, see QueryMetricByPage (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/186100.htm?spm=a2cdw.13409063.0.0.7a72281f0bkTfx#title-imy-7gj-qhr)
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的应用监控>应用列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx
parameters.name: pid

fields.help_en: The ID of the reason for deletion
fields.name: id

fields.example:
删除理由描述，ID和Name的对应关系：
"id":0,"name":"功能不完善，无法定位到问题根本原因。"
"id":1,"name":"Agent不稳定，影响应用运行。"
"id":2,"name":"服务不稳定，经常打不开界面。"
"id":3,"name":"报警相关问题。"
"id":4,"name":"价格太贵"
"id":5,"name":"其他原因"
fields.help_en: A description of the reason for removal
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: Additional remarks when none of the reasons for removal provided are met
fields.help_zh: 其他删除原因的备注信息
fields.name: remark

Code.description_en: The status code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 接口状态码：2XX：成功                                 3XX：重定向                                 4XX：请求错误                                 5XX：服务器错误

Data.description_en: The response in JSON format, including the HTTP status code, error code, response message, and trace ID
Data.description_zh: JSON格式的返回结果，包含HTTP状态码、错误码、返回消息、TraceId等

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功：

`true`：操作成功
`false`：操作失败
